name: Garden Path

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: You can guide your crop to move unnoticed through dangerous situations. When you and any of your crop are Avoiding Notice, you can choose yourself or one member of your crop to temporarily gain the benefits of the Quiet Allies skill feat until the group is no longer Avoiding Notice. The group rolls two checks instead of one, using the higher die roll.
